'''Antonio Acín Dal Maschio''' is a Spanish theoretical physicist, currently an [[Catalan Institution for Research and Advanced Studies|ICREA]] professor at [[ICFO – The Institute of Photonic Sciences]] in [[Castelldefels]], near [[Barcelona]].<ref name="icrea">{{cite web|url=https://www.icrea.cat/Web/ScientificStaff/antonio-acin-dal-maschio-412|title=Acín Dal Maschio, Antonio|publisher=ICREA|access-date=3 April 2023}}</ref>

==Research interests==
Acín's primary research interest lies in [[quantum information theory]], with a particular focus on [[Quantum entanglement|entanglement]] characterization and [[quantum nonlocality]]. He is also involved in developing [[quantum communication]] protocols, emphasizing [[quantum cryptography]] and [[randomness]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ritce2020.hbar.es/news/articles/interview-antonio-acin/|title=Interview: Antonio Acín (ICFO)|date=31 August 2015 |access-date=3 April 2023}}</ref>

==Education==
Antonio Acín received his undergraduate education in both [[Telecommunication Engineering]] at the [[Polytechnic University of Catalonia]] from 1990 to 1997 and [[Physics]] at the [[University of Barcelona]] from 1993 to 1997. He then pursued his doctoral studies at the University of Barcelona and earned his [[Doctorate]] in [[Theoretical Physics]] in 2001.<ref name="icrea" />

==Research career==
Antonio Acín began his research career as a post-doctoral researcher at the [[University of Geneva]]'s GAP-Optique with [[Nicolas Gisin]] from October 2001 to March 2003, focusing on theoretical aspects of [[quantum information]]. In April 2003, he moved to [[ICFO – The Institute of Photonic Sciences]], where he continued his post-doctoral work until December 2004. Acín then transitioned into a faculty position at ICFO, serving as an assistant professor from January 2005 to December 2007. He was subsequently promoted to Professor in January 2008. Later that year in September 2008, Acín was appointed as an [[ICREA]] Professor at [[ICFO – The Institute of Photonic Sciences]].<ref>{{cite web|title=People|url=https://www.icfo.eu/research-group/7/quantum-information/people/437/|access-date=Apr 4, 2023}}</ref>

Acín's research has been recognized with several grants and awards, such as the [[European Research Council]] (ERC) Advanced Grant CERQUTE (2020–2024),<ref>{{cite web |title=The European Research Council awards ICFO two new Advanced Grants |url=https://www.icfo.eu/news/1557/the-european-research-council-awards-icfo-two-new-advanced-grants-/ |website=ICFO |access-date=4 April 2023}}</ref> ERC Consolidator Grant QITBOX (2014–2019),<ref>{{cite web |title=Quantum Information Theory with black BOXes |url=https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/617337/es |access-date=5 April 2023}}</ref> ERC Proof-of-Concept MAMBO (2012–2013),<ref>{{cite web |title=ERC Consolidator Grant |url=https://www.icfo.eu/es/noticias/693/erc-consolidator-grant/ |website=ICFO |access-date=4 April 2023 |language=es}}</ref> and ERC Starting Grant PERCENT (2008–2013).<ref>{{cite web|title=Antonio Acín, investigador ICREA de l'ICFO, rep una de les noves 'Consolidator Grants' del Consell Europeu de Recerca |url=https://saladepremsa2.upc.edu/al-dia/mes-noticies/licfo-rep-una-de-les-noves-2018consolidator-grants2019-del-consell-de-recerca-europea.html|language=ca|access-date=Apr 4, 2023}}</ref> He was also awarded the [[AXA]] Chair in Quantum Information Science,<ref>{{cite web|title=A Quantum Revolution in Data Security|url=https://www.axa-research.org/en/project/antonio-acin|access-date=Apr 4, 2023}}</ref> the prize "[[La Recherche]]" in 2011<ref>{{cite web |title=Le Prix La Recherche |url=https://www.icfo.eu/news/375/le-prix-la-recherche-/ |website=ICFO |access-date=4 April 2023}}</ref> and the [[Paul Ehrenfest]] Best Paper Award for Quantum Foundations in 2018<ref>{{cite web |title=2018 PAUL EHRENFEST BEST PAPER AWARD FOR QUANTUM FOUNDATIONS |url=https://www.iqoqi-vienna.at/detail/news/2018-paul-ehrenfest-best-paper-award-for-quantum-foundations/ |website=www.iqoqi-vienna.at |access-date=4 April 2023}}</ref> and 2022.<ref>{{cite web |title=2022 |url=https://www.iqoqi-vienna.at/news-events/ehrenfest-award/2022 |website=www.iqoqi-vienna.at |access-date=4 April 2023}}</ref>

Acín has served on the Scientific Advisory Board of several research institutes, including the [[Centre for Quantum Technologies]] in Singapore,<ref>{{cite web|title=Scientific Advisory Board Members|url=https://www.quantumlah.org/scientific-advisory-board/|access-date=Apr 4, 2023}}</ref> the [[Institute for Quantum Optics and Quantum Information]] in Vienna,<ref>{{cite web|title=Scientific Advisory Board|url=https://www.iqoqi-vienna.at/de/the-institute/scientific-advisory-board|access-date=Apr 4, 2023}}</ref> and the International Advisory Council of the [[International Institute of Physics]] in Natal.<ref>{{cite web|title=International Advisory Council|url=https://www.iip.ufrn.br/councillors|access-date=Apr 4, 2023}}</ref>

== Popular Science Work ==
Antonio Acín has been involved in promoting scientific understanding among the general public. He has given a number of educational talks aimed at non-scientists<ref>{{cite web|title=ICFO at MACBA|url=https://www.icfo.eu/news/240/icfo-at-macba-/|access-date=Apr 4, 2023}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Antonio Acín|url=https://www.cccb.org/en/participants/file/antonio-acin/231121|access-date=Apr 4, 2023}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last1=Acín |first1=Antonio |title=La segunda revolución cuántica - Antonio Acín - TEDxBarcelona|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9kHAKwcRhtY |website=youtube.com |publisher=TEDx |language=es |format=video |date=Dec 9, 2016}}</ref> and written several popular science articles.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Acín |first1=Antonio |last2=Navascués |first2=Miguel |title=Criptografía cuántica |journal=Revista Española de Física |date=1 March 2008 |volume=21 |issue=2 |pages=5–9 |url=http://www.revistadefisica.es/index.php/ref/article/view/2496/0 |language=es |issn=0213-862X}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=La certeza del azar cuántico |url=http://sgpwe.izt.uam.mx/files/users/uami/pcha/AzarCuant.pdf|language=es |access-date=4 April 2023}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |last1=Acín |first1=Antonio |last2=Perarnau-Llobet |first2=Martí |last3=Riera |first3=Arnau |title=Termodinámica Cuántica |journal=Revista Española de Física |date=26 June 2019 |volume=33 |issue=2 |pages=15–24 |url=https://revistadefisica.es/index.php/ref/article/view/2492 |language=es |issn=0213-862X}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |last1=Renou |first1=Marc-Olivier |last2=Acín |first2=Antonio |last3=Navascués |first3=Miguel |title=Quantum Physics Falls Apart without Imaginary Numbers |journal=Scientific American|date=1 April 2023 |url=https://www.scientificamerican.com/article/quantum-physics-falls-apart-without-imaginary-numbers/ |language=en }}</ref> He is also the author of a book.<ref>{{cite book |last=Acín |first=Antonio |date=2021 |title=Einstein y la intuición |trans-title=Einstein and intuition |url=https://www.casadellibro.com/libro-einstein-y-la-intuicion/9788413610894/12613382 |language=es |location=Spain |publisher=Shackleton books |isbn=978-84-1361-089-4}}</ref>
